cases.name: avatar-default
cases.summary: The sample avatar with the default parameter values.

cases.name: avatar-pose
cases.summary: Head and body turned, one eye half closed, gaze, brows and an open smiling mouth (warps rotated from depth, blend shapes, opacity switches and masks).

cases.name: avatar-clamped
cases.summary: Values outside the ranges are clamped; closed eyes.

cases.name: avatar-physics
cases.summary: Half a second of dynamic physics (hair and earrings) after turning the head.

cases.name: avatar-effects
cases.summary: Two seconds with eye blink and breathing (the eye blink uses the model's seed).

cases.name: avatar-lit
cases.summary: The lit sample (normal maps) with ambient light, a directional light from the upper left and a point light.

cases.name: dress-up-base
cases.summary: The dress-up base without modules.

cases.name: dress-up-long-hair
cases.summary: Three modules attached (hair, headwear and outfit): composed meshes, textures after the base's, masks into the base.

cases.name: dress-up-twin-tails
cases.summary: Modules with physics rigs, advanced in time.

cases.name: avatar-moving
cases.summary: The head turned right after being drawn turned the other way (checks that no frame lags behind, e.g. the masks).

cases.name: masks-nested
cases.summary: Nested masks (white of the eye, iris, pupil) with colors and a translucent texture.

cases.name: masks-mixed
cases.summary: Normal and inverted masks on the same mesh.

cases.name: masks-intersection
cases.summary: A mesh drawn where several masks intersect.

cases.name: masks-many
cases.summary: One mesh read by twelve masks (three inverted).

cases.name: masks-moving
cases.summary: Nested masks moved by a parameter right after being drawn at the other end.

cases.name: blend-modes
cases.summary: Multiply, additive and normal blending, multiply and screen colors, and back-face culling.

cases.name: ktx2-avatar
cases.summary: The sample avatar with its textures as uncompressed R8G8B8A8_SRGB KTX2 (non-premultiplied, values used as stored), posed.

cases.name: ktx2-avatar-lit
cases.summary: The lit sample with its textures and normal maps as R8G8B8A8_SRGB KTX2, lit as avatar-lit.

cases.name: ktx2-mips
cases.summary: Nested masks with a zstd-supercompressed R8G8B8A8_UNORM KTX2 texture whose smaller mip levels are magenta (only level 0 is used).

cases.name: ktx2-bc3-avatar
cases.summary: The sample avatar with its textures as block-compressed BC3_UNORM KTX2 (decoded, then premultiplied), posed as ktx2-avatar.

cases.name: ktx2-bc-avatar-lit
cases.summary: The lit sample with zstd-supercompressed BC7_SRGB KTX2 textures and BC1_RGB_UNORM KTX2 normal maps, lit as avatar-lit.

cases.name: bundle-single-quad-zstd
cases.summary: A bundle whose chunks are compressed with zstd.

cases.name: bundle-optional-feature
cases.summary: A bundle that declares an unknown optional feature (read with the fallback).

cases.name: bundle-lit-quads
cases.summary: Lit quads with normal maps, lit by a directional light.

cases.name: bundle-physics-pendulum
cases.summary: The pendulum of the physics example, one second after moving its input.

cases.name: avatar-follow
cases.summary: A follower (T0133): one second of values from a conductor with physics off (head turned, the standard eye blink and breathing), applied with follow so that only physics and the pose run.

cases.name: dress-up-follow
cases.summary: A follower with modules attached (the values follow the composed parameters).

cases.name: lip-sync-follow
cases.summary: A follower (T0134) of a model whose lip sync drives a physics input (AngleX of dynamic hair): the conductor sends the values before physics and the lip sync level and strength, and follow applies physics, then lip sync, in the order of a single puppet.

cases.name: part-switch-follow
cases.summary: A follower (T0135) of a motion with part opacity curves: the conductor plays `switch` (a pose switch from ArmA to ArmB and a fading Badge, with fade in and out) and sends the curves, and follow applies them with the follower's own pose, in the order of a single puppet.

cases.name: avatar-conduct
cases.summary: A conductor inside the runner (T0454): avatar-follow, but the runner plays the conductor itself and follows the values it reads back from the conductor (values before physics, lip sync applied, part opacity curves), instead of the values in the plan.

cases.name: lip-sync-conduct
cases.summary: lip-sync-follow with the conductor inside the runner (T0454): the runner sets the lip sync level of each frame on its conductor and passes the lip sync it reads back to the follower.

cases.name: part-switch-conduct
cases.summary: part-switch-follow with the conductor inside the runner (T0454): the runner's conductor plays `switch` and the follower gets the part opacity curves read back from it.
